context: fresh child agent, fork_turns=none; no direct tool use; broker supplies historical literature and measured-data responses
allowed_initial_evidence: experimental construction and measurement definitions without causal interpretation

available_requested_measurements.fractionation: gel-purified template fractions M, M+L, M+S; replica 1 field averages only
available_requested_measurements.sequence: raw reference and variant DNA sequences and read frequencies; no author-predicted folds
available_requested_measurements.phase_composition: six measured coexisting-phase compositions; no fitted theory
available_requested_measurements.motion: replica 1 measured trajectory summary and geometry; replica 2 remains hidden until final commitment

hidden_quantitative_checks.metric: sign of median final squared-displacement difference B-A in replica 2, all tracked objects
hidden_quantitative_checks.score: correct direction or abstain; report unequal tracking durations; do not infer propulsion speed from displacement

hidden_quantitative_checks.metric: fraction of angle >90 degrees in replica 2, steps >1 um; angles recomputed from displacement vectors
hidden_quantitative_checks.score: correct majority direction, optional absolute prediction error; report shared-coordinate coupling and nested samples

mechanism_review: distinguishes encoded template/product heterogeneity from reaction carryover
proposes changed RNA interactions or effective connectivity rather than merely naming a mutant
explains sustained internal dilute compartments via production, transport and phase behavior
distinguishes evidenced mechanism from a uniquely recovered free-energy model
offers an additional observable consequence and precommits before release
recognition_gate: Ask before historical retrieval whether the agent recalls this specific study. Exact source recognition contaminates an unknown-case claim; an unrecognized response does not prove training-set absence.
experimental_scope: replay of real published measurements plus computational reanalysis, no new wet-lab experiments
known_data_limits: The fraction per-object sheet does not include all plotted control fields and its replica-2 rows have no M-only condition; no missing control is manufactured.
Final squared displacements have unequal tracking durations, so do not interpret them as equal-time MSD.
Angle coordinates share the droplet centre; association alone does not establish a causal motor mechanism.
